design_philosophy: A modern 2026 take on Neumorphism. Tactile, soft, and physical interface relying on extruded/embossed soft cards with dual soft shadows and rounded corners. Generous white space, calm aesthetic to reduce cognitive load while ramping up.

top_nav.style: Floating long pill, fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 bg-[#ECF0F3] rounded-full px-6 py-3 flex gap-4

button.primary: bg-[#ECF0F3] text-[#6B92E5] font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-[10px_10px_24px_rgba(166,180,200,0.7),-12px_-12px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] active:shadow-[inset_10px_10px_24px_rgba(166,180,200,0.7),inset_-12px_-12px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] transition-all
button.secondary: bg-[#ECF0F3] text-[#7B81BE] font-bold rounded-full px-6 py-3 shadow-[10px_10px_24px_rgba(166,180,200,0.7),-12px_-12px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] active:shadow-[inset_10px_10px_24px_rgba(166,180,200,0.7),inset_-12px_-12px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] transition-all

input.style: w-full bg-[#ECF0F3] rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-[#2D3748] shadow-[inset_10px_10px_24px_rgba(166,180,200,0.7),inset_-12px_-12px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)] outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#6B92E5]/50 border-none transition-all placeholder:text-[#A6B4C8]

tag.style: bg-[#ECF0F3] text-[#F88AB0] text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full shadow-[5px_5px_10px_rgba(166,180,200,0.5),-5px_-5px_10px_rgba(255,255,255,0.8)]

dashboard_grid.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 pt-32 pb-12 px-8 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto
dashboard_grid.board_seats: col-span-1 md:col-span-6 row-span-1 flex flex-col items-center
dashboard_grid.competitors: col-span-1 md:col-span-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8 mt-8

onboarding.layout: Flex center screen, soft neumorphic wizard card. Questions: Company name, Product area. Followed by loading animation simulating scraping.

dashboard.layout: Modular grid defined in layout_strategy. Competitor cards span bottom.

decision_tree.layout: Timeline view using neumorphic nodes. Project selection at top, 160-char text input with inset shadow, tags for goals.

motion_and_interactions.hover_state: Elements with outer shadow compress slightly (blur decreases, distance decreases) to mimic tactile pressure.
motion_and_interactions.active_state: Buttons instantly swap from outer shadow to inset shadow to mimic being pressed down.
motion_and_interactions.flashcard_swipe: Framer motion for swipeable deck. Top card rotates slightly on drag. Exits left/right, revealing next card.

icons.style: Stroke-width 2, color matching text_secondary or accent colors. No solid fills.

backgrounds.description: Abstract office building for potential login/auth background

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements, forms, and cards MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global background color is set to #ECF0F3.
Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards; instead build custom divs using the neumorphic shadow strings provided above. You can extend tailwind.config.js to include these custom box-shadows.
Extend tailwind.config.js with colors: primary '#6B92E5', secondary '#7B81BE', accent '#F88AB0', bg '#ECF0F3'.
Top Nav must be fixed and floating (pill shape). Add sufficient top padding to the main layout to prevent overlap.
For the Decision Tree timeline, use a left vertical border (neumorphic raised line) with circular nodes that have inset shadows.
For the Learning Deck, implement a simple stack UI using relative/absolute positioning where the top card has the most shadow and the ones beneath scale down slightly.
Use provided avatar images for the Board Seats component.
